text:
Raj: hey folks — stuck in the airport security line, my flight's delayed. i can't make the 22:00->06:00 EU->APAC bridge tonight. i'm currently primary for the window. there's an active pager that just came in (see incident-bot below). can someone pick up primary for tonight? i'll stay reachable by DM for a fast handoff.

incident-bot: [ALERT] Pager P2: increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (prod-us-west). initial detection 2063456745. current rate 4.8% (threshold 1.0%). severity: impacted but customers degrading slowly. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-5xx (automated summary attached).

Michelle: I can take primary for the overnight window. i'm heading home but can be on-call from phone. Raj — can you DM me any in-flight state or the last actions you ran? also confirm who will be secondary.

Raj: thanks @Michelle — DM'd the list of recent deploys and the small debug snippet I ran (kubectl logs + restart ingress-cache). nothing major, just increasing error rate. i added the short checklist to the runbook under "short-term mitigation".

Sam: i can be secondary. can we add an explicit escalation path? last time there was confusion between SRE and runtime team. suggest: 1) primary -> try runbook mitigations, 2) if >10% error or 15m no improvement escalate to SRE channel and page oncall-sre, 3) open incident bridge if customers >10% error or major SLA blips.

Olivia (EM): +1 on the explicit escalation steps. also log customer-impact notes in the incident tracker (link in runbook). Raj, Michelle — please note if any customers reported dropped tokens or timeouts so we can include in post-incident notes.

Michelle: noted. quick handoff notes:
- checked relevant pods in prod-us-west: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-prod | grep api` (no restarts in last 5m).
- restarted `ingress-cache` once: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-cache -n redwood-prod` (gave temporary drop in errors).
- temporary mitigation candidate: increase cache-ttl to 30s via configmap `ingress-cache-config` (risky but buys time).
- runbook snippet I used:```
# check logs for 502 pattern
kubectl -n redwood-prod logs -l app=ingress-cache --tail=200 | grep -i "504"
# if repeated 5xx from backend, roll back last deploy: kubectl rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=<rev>
```

Raj: adding that to the thread — i also toggled a feature flag for a small client-side fallback, which lowered tokenization failures for one customer. flag is `ff/fallback-tokenizer` in launchdarkly.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] error rate stabilized to 2.1% after ingress-cache restart and small config tweak (2063456798). monitoring for 15m window.

Michelle: i'll take primary now. plan for the next hour: monitor error rate, if >3% for 10m start rollback plan (Sam can coordinate with runtime team). will log actions every 15m in this thread and update incident tracker.

Sam: i'll be on standby and can page runtime or SRE if rollback needed. Sam -> runtime lead @runtime-lead. also will watch customer-facing metrics in Grafana (dashboard: prod-api/errors).

Olivia (EM): thank you team — appreciate the quick coverage swap. Michelle, once stable, please leave a short post-shift note for Raj about actions taken and any follow-ups so we can capture in the retrospective.

Michelle: got it. quick note now: picked up primary at 2063456799, restarted ingress-cache, increased cache-ttl to 30s as temporary mitigation, monitoring. will update next at ~2063456899 or earlier if anything changes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [RESOLVE-CANDIDATE] error rate under 1% for 10m (2063456842). please confirm stable before auto-clear.

Raj: thanks all — appreciate the cover. Michelle, I'll sync in the morning with handoff notes. safe flight for me.

Michelle: confirming stable at 2063456850, leaving thread to Sam for secondary watch. logging the actions in incident tracker now.

Sam: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye until 06:00 APAC window starts. if anything spikes i'll re-alert and open bridge.

Olivia (EM): recorded participants and actions in the incident tracker. no major customer outages reported from support; keeping as P2. good job on the fast handoff and clear runbook references.
